footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Titan International: after $2.3M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 0.9% to $1.8B in 2025. Gross margin was 13.9%, versus 14.0% a year earlier, and operating income fell 37.4% to $20.8M, a 1.1% margin.
The net loss widened to $63.5M, or −$1.00 per share, from $5.6M. Operating cash flow was $30.0M and free cash flow −$24.6M, versus $75.9M.
sources: Titan International, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
